════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
            RDK-E MIDDLEWARE DOCKER DEPLOYMENT GUIDE
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

📦 WHAT'S IN THIS FOLDER:
├── scripts/              - Start/stop/restart/status automation scripts
├── docker-files/         - Dockerfile and docker-compose configuration  
├── config/               - Application configuration files
└── documentation/        - Full markdown documentation

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
                    🚀 QUICK DEPLOYMENT (3 STEPS)
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

STEP 1: Copy this folder to target machine
  $ scp -r RDK-Middleware-USB/ pi-user@TARGET_IP:/home/pi/

STEP 2: SSH into target machine
  $ ssh pi-user@TARGET_IP
  $ cd RDK-Middleware-USB

STEP 3: Run startup script
  $ ./scripts/start-rdk-app.sh
  
✅ Done! Access dashboard at: http://TARGET_IP:11078

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
                       📋 SCRIPT USAGE
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Start application:
  $ ./scripts/start-rdk-app.sh

Stop application:
  $ ./scripts/stop-rdk-app.sh

Restart application:
  $ ./scripts/restart-rdk-app.sh

Check status:
  $ ./scripts/status-rdk-app.sh

View logs:
  $ sudo docker logs rdk-middleware-dashboard -f

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
                    🔍 MANUAL DEPLOYMENT (ADVANCED)
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

1. Build Docker image:
   $ cd docker-files
   $ sudo docker build -f Dockerfile.production -t rdk-middleware:latest .

2. Start with docker-compose:
   $ sudo docker compose -f docker-compose.rpi.clean.yml up -d

3. Verify running:
   $ docker ps | grep rdk-middleware

4. Access dashboard:
   http://YOUR_IP:11078

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
                         🛠️ TROUBLESHOOTING
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Issue: Docker daemon not running
Solution: sudo systemctl start docker

Issue: Permission denied
Solution: sudo usermod -aG docker $USER && newgrp docker

Issue: Port 11078 already in use
Solution: sudo docker compose down && ./scripts/start-rdk-app.sh

Issue: Image doesn't exist
Solution: ./scripts/start-rdk-app.sh (will build automatically)
